name: roots
title: Root System Analysis
subtitle: Calibrated root-system metrics, with SmartRoot for full tracing
description: Whole-root-system metrics from a calibrated image: total length, projected area, depth, lateral spread, convex hull and root length density. One summary row per image.
method: Rolling-ball background subtraction (radius 50 px) to flatten plate illumination, Otsu threshold, despeckle+open, then a core-ImageJ binary skeleton. Total length = skeleton pixel count x pixel width. This build has no Fiji Ridge Detection or AnalyzeSkeleton, so per-lateral topology is not computed here; trace with Plugins > SmartRoot > Trace current image for that.
dataType: root systems on plates or rhizotrons, dark roots on a pale background

outputs.name: TotalLength
outputs.label: Total root length
outputs.description: Skeleton length summed over the whole root system. Approximate: under-reads diagonal runs by up to ~8%.

outputs.name: RootSystemArea
outputs.label: Projected root area
outputs.description: Thresholded area of the root system

outputs.name: MaxDepth
outputs.label: Maximum depth
outputs.description: Bounding-box height of the root system

outputs.name: LateralSpread
outputs.label: Lateral spread
outputs.description: Bounding-box width of the root system

outputs.name: ConvexHullArea
outputs.label: Convex hull area
outputs.description: Area of the convex hull enclosing the root system

outputs.name: RootLengthDensity
outputs.label: Root length density
outputs.description: Total length divided by convex hull area

notes: Lateral root number (TO:0001013) requires SmartRoot tracing (Plugins > SmartRoot > Trace current image) and is not produced by this macro.

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
